question: Can known-interface Earth temperature observations distinguish overburden/material response from an ice-interface response, and what can this add to interpreting MS-01?

primary_printed_date_window.reason: Preserve the previous W analysis window instead of selecting a new window after inspecting amplitudes.
primary_printed_date_window.clock_status: Author printed timestamps only; no UTC/LTST conversion or independently verified cross-logger synchronization.

input_preference: 2009-2010 author good-only calibrated HOBO exports for S/M/D/W; Campbell W retained as prior separate-instrument example, no cross-instrument join.
mapping_rule: Match file columns using author headers, deployment/QA records and paper. A filename is not sufficient proof of a channel depth or logger identity. Conflicts remain explicit.
coverage_rule: Report whole-file and primary-window counts/missingness. Use actual common finite records without interpolation. Retain a calendar grid only to display gaps. If primary support is inadequate, record that result before considering another explicitly justified window.
descriptive_model: T = intercept + centered linear time + bsin*sin(2*pi*t/24h) + bcos*cos(2*pi*t/24h). Half-amplitude = hypot(bsin,bcos), not peak-to-peak.
comparison_rule: Separate within-logger depth ratios from cross-logger and cross-site comparisons. Shared printed dates do not establish identical forcing, actual simultaneity or causal control.
sensitivity_rule: Report leave-one-printed-day-out fit range as a descriptive stability check, not a confidence interval or proof of independent daily samples. Do not use sample count to remove systematic sensor uncertainty.
interpretation_limits: No thermal-inertia, ice-depth, ice-abundance or detection-accuracy inversion.
No cross-site causal attribution to ice depth alone: shade, radiation, wind, material, moisture and contact/exposure can differ.
No MS-01 temperature subtraction, Earth-to-Mars parameter transfer, similarity score or new-method claim.
Ice truth at Earth sites is prior external information, not a discovery produced by this fit.
stop_condition: Deliver a verified bounded comparison or explicit insufficient-support finding, an observation/interpretation/alternative table, and a disposition/value conclusion for University Valley and Beacon Valley. Only MS-01 paths and PR #8 are updated.
